title: ObserveParams
description:
Parameters for `tool.observe` — produce a semantic VOM observation for one tab plus a fresh `@e<N>` ref-store on the extension side.

Unlike `tool.snapshot`, this path may run bounded perception probes such as hover-surface discovery. It must not submit input, click, navigate, or otherwise commit page state.

debug_surfaces.description: Include implementation diagnostics for conditional surface probes.

max_depth.description: Cap the depth of the rendered VOM tree.

max_tokens.description: Soft cap on rendered tokens (approximate; extension uses a best-effort heuristic based on character count).

tab_id.description: Optional target tab. Defaults to the Agent Window's currently active tab.
